additionalAbilities.name: Split
additionalAbilities.description: When a Pugnacious Puddle that is Medium or larger is subjected to slashing or lightning damage, it splits into two new Pugnacious Puddles if it has at least 10 hit points. On a failed save, the Pugnacious Puddle enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and is engulfed. additionalAbilities.name: Constructed Resilience

additionalAbilities.name: Elite Tactician
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, the Darkwatch can give a telepathic command to an allied Darkling or Darkforged creature it can see within 120 feet. That ally can use its reaction to move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

additionalAbilities.name: Degenerate Regeneration
additionalAbilities.description: If unwounded for 1 round, the Darkwatch begins to coalesce its dark essence. At the start of its turn, it can restore 1d8 hit points provided it has not taken radiant damage since its last turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Darkwatch makes two attacks with its Suppression Cannon or two attacks with its Energy Blade.

actions.name: Suppression Cannon
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 40/80 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) force damage, and the target's speed is halved until the end of its next turn. A creature can only be affected by this speed reduction once per round.

actions.name: Energy Blade

actions.name: Stasis Grenade (Recharge 5-6)

additionalAbilities.name: Fear Aura

actions.name: Psychic Pulse (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The Psychic Bloom releases a wave of psychic energy. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must make a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Tendril Slam

additionalAbilities.description: The Planar Warden is immune to effects that would teleport it or move it to another plane of existence against its will.

additionalAbilities.name: Dimensional Seal (3/Day)
additionalAbilities.description: As an action, the Planar Warden can attempt to temporarily seal a minor dimensional seam or temporal flux zone within 30 feet. This requires a successful DC 14 Intelligence (Arcana) check. If successful, the anomaly is suppressed for 1d4 hours.

actions.name: Stabilizing Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) force damage. If the target is a creature that originated from another plane, it must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away.

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: The Echo Inquisitor can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Echo Inquisitor regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Temporal Paradox
additionalAbilities.description: When the Echo Inquisitor hits a creature with an attack, the target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be afflicted by a temporal paradox. On a failed save, the target takes an extra 3d6 psychic damage and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn as its movements are briefly out of sync with time.

additionalAbilities.name: Planar Shift (Recharge 5-6)
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, the Echo Inquisitor can teleport up to 60 feet. After teleporting, it can choose one creature within 10 feet of its destination. actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Echo Inquisitor makes two Temporal Lash attacks.

actions.name: Temporal Lash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) force damage.

legendaryActions.name: Flicker (1 Action)

legendaryActions.name: Echo Gaze (2 Actions)

legendaryActions.name: Reality Warp (3 Actions)

actions.name: Lightning Pulse (Recharge 5-6)

additionalAbilities.name: Lesson in Pain

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Rod of Correction
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Spank! (Recharge 5-6)

additionalAbilities.name: Strict Scrutiny
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, the Professor targets one creature it can see within 60 feet. The Professor has advantage on its next spell attack roll against that creature before the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Punishing Touch
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) psychic damage.

actions.name: Spank! (Spell, Cantrip)
